name_zh: 玛格丽特·阿特伍德/原住民艺术家：离散叙事与加拿大书写
name_en: Margaret Atwood/Indigenous Artists: Diasporic Narrative & Canadian Writing
description_zh: 玛格丽特·阿特伍德 (1939-) 《使女的故事》/《盲刺客》/《奥丽克与克雷克》三部曲，以推想小说重构加拿大生存焦虑：严冬/荒野/殖民/性别/环境崩溃；原住民艺术家群体 (诺瓦利亚/肯·奥吉克/丽贝卡·贝尔莫) 以装置/行为/影像重构"龟岛"本体论——土地即法律、记忆即抵抗、创作即治愈。跨定居者/原住民两大传统，共同体现 M165 离散叙事书写——以"生存叙事+土地本体论+记忆导航"三重技法，在殖民创伤中重构文化主权。
description_en: Margaret Atwood (1939-) 'Handmaid's Tale'/'Blind Assassin'/'Oryx and Crake' trilogy, speculative fiction reconstructs Canadian survival anxieties: harsh winter/wilderness/colonialism/gender/ecological collapse; Indigenous artist collective (Norval Morrisseau/Kenojuak Ashevak/Rebecca Belmore) via installation/performance/video reconstruct 'Turtle Island' ontology—land as law, memory as resistance, creation as healing. Across settler/indigenous two traditions, jointly exemplify M165 Diasporic Narrative Writing—triple technique of 'survival narrative + land ontology + memory navigation' reconstructing cultural sovereignty amid colonial trauma.
reason_zh: 加拿大文学非单一民族书写，而是"定居者生存焦虑+原住民土地本体论"双重张力场。阿特伍德以推想小说投射集体无意识，原住民艺术家以土地本体论重构主权。M165 区隔于 M155 魔幻现实(拉美)、M154 梦境时间(澳洲)，核心在于"殖民创伤语境下的双重文化主权重构"。
reason_en: Canadian literature not single-nation writing but dual tension field of 'settler survival anxiety + indigenous land ontology'. Atwood projects collective unconscious via speculative fiction, indigenous artists reconstruct sovereignty via land ontology. M165 distinct from M155 Magical Realism (Latin America) and M154 Dreamtime Navigation (Australia), core: 'dual cultural sovereignty reconstruction under colonial trauma context'.
steps_zh: 生存叙事确立：阿特伍德《生存》确立加拿大文学核心主题——生存而非胜利，严冬/荒野/殖民者身份
推想小说投射焦虑：《使女的故事》神权极权/《奥丽克与克雷克》生物技术崩溃，技术/环境/性别三重恐惧
原住民土地本体论重构：莫里索《药轮》、奥吉克《因纽特母神》、贝尔莫《警觉》装置，土地即法律/记忆/主权
记忆导航与真相和解：TRC 94 项呼吁/寄宿学校档案/语言复振，创作成治愈/证言/抵抗三合一
跨文化对话与共同未来：阿特伍德支持原住民权利/原住民艺术家参与主流双年展，双重主权走向共生
steps_en: Survival narrative establishment: Atwood's 'Survival' defines Canadian lit core theme—survival not victory, harsh winter/wilderness/settler identity
Speculative fiction projecting anxieties: 'Handmaid's Tale' theocratic totalitarianism/'Oryx and Crake' biotech collapse, tech/environment/gender triple fear
Indigenous land ontology reconstruction: Morrisseau 'Medicine Wheel'/Ashevak 'Inuit Mother Goddess'/Belmore 'Vigil' installation, land as law/memory/sovereignty
Memory navigation & truth reconciliation: TRC 94 Calls/residential school archives/language revitalization, creation as healing/testimony/resistance triad
Cross-cultural dialogue & shared future: Atwood supports indigenous rights/indigenous artists in mainstream biennales, dual sovereignty toward symbiosis
expected_zh: 以"生存叙事+土地本体论+记忆导航"三重技法，在殖民创伤中重构定居者/原住民双重文化主权，加拿大文学国际话语权长期全球前列。
expected_en: Triple technique of 'survival narrative + land ontology + memory navigation' reconstructs settler/indigenous dual cultural sovereignty amid colonial trauma, Canadian literature international discourse power consistently global top tier.
case_zh: 阿特伍德 布克奖/总督奖/诺贝尔奖提名；原住民艺术家威尼斯双年展/多伦多双年展/国家美术馆收藏；加拿大文学研究全球学科标准。
case_en: Atwood Booker/Governor General/Nobel nomination; indigenous artists Venice Biennale/Toronto Biennial/National Gallery collections; Canadian literature studies global disciplinary standard.
intellectual_tradition: Canadian Diasporic Literature / Indigenous Land Ontology
cross_cultural_impact: Speculative fiction as social critique; indigenous art as sovereignty practice; TRC cultural dimension
diaspora_influence: Canadian literary diaspora global; Atwood global icon
indigenous_knowledge_system: Anishinaabe/Inuit/Cree/Métis land-based knowledge; oral storytelling; medicine wheel
